230:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

230:t_1:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「...To think we'd end up fighting the $$サイデリアル$$ crowd right here in the center of the galaxy.」

230:t_1:5.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Don't tell me... they followed us here?」

230:t_1:6.en:
$$マリー$$
「But if so, that means the $$サイデリアル$$ have a way to travel between Earth and the center of the galaxy.」

230:t_1:9.en:
$$レド$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ operate mainly here, in the center of the galaxy.」

230:t_1:10.en:
$$レド$$
「To me, as someone who belonged to the $$人類銀河同盟$$, it seems strange that they'd put a strong force like Reactors on Earth, out on the galactic frontier, and...」

230:t_1:11.en:
$$レド$$
「...even keep $$アウストラリス$$, the ruler of the $$サイデリアル$$, there. That looks even more unnatural to me.」

230:t_1:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think it was to obtain Earth's $$次元力$$.」

230:t_1:13.en:
$$レド$$
「Now I can understand that, too. But the bulk of their strength is still the force at the center of the galaxy.」

230:t_1:14.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't know what they intended by deploying troops to this region, but we'll need to be prepared accordingly.」

230:t_1:15.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「So a larger force than any we've faced so far is coming...」

230:t_1:16.en:
$$刹那$$
「But... we have no choice but to fight.」

230:t_1:17.en:
$$シン$$
「Yeah... We've also gathered information on the end of the universe. We have to get that back to Earth, too.」

230:t_1:18.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I don't understand the logic, but if we can defeat $$バアル$$, the universe won't collapse...」

230:t_1:19.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「That's right. We have to fight $$バアル$$ too, so we can't afford to die in a place like this.」

230:t_1:20.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「$n, Miss $$スズネ$$... The information you two brought us gave us hope.」

230:t_1:23.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Well... it's embarrassing to say, but...」

230:t_1:24.en:
$$スズネ$$
「After that will of the $$プロトカルチャー$$ appeared, I... don't remember much of what happened.」

230:t_1:25.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Get a grip, Miss $$スズネ$$. However much you love the occult, you got way too carried away.」

230:t_1:26.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're right... Lately I've been terribly forgetful, but I'll be more careful.」

230:t_1:28.en:
$$アルト$$
「The $$ＹＦ－２９$$... So I can use this thing...」

230:t_1:29.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Fold Quartz research was moving forward in the $$マクロス７船団$$ too, you see...」

230:t_1:30.en:
$$オズマ$$
「They sent us those materials, and the repairs on this thing are done. Show me you can master it, $$アルト$$.」

230:t_1:34.en:
$$アルト$$
「This $$ＹＦ－２９$$ was originally developed to deliver your songs...」

230:t_1:35.en:
$$アルト$$
「But now... I'm going to fight with it to protect you.」

230:t_1:36.en:
$$ランカ$$
「I believe in you, $$アルト$$...」

230:t_1:37.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Make sure you come back. Or else...」

230:t_1:38.en:
$$アルト$$
「I don't need to hear the rest. I already know. ...Wait for me, $$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$.」

230:t_2:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But what on earth is it for...」

230:t_2:8.en:
???
「Do you want some answer other than that?」

230:t_2:10.en:
???
「Do not forget hope, accursed wanderer. Your journey's end is near.」

230:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I don't understand... What on earth for...」

230:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just kidding! How unlike me to get all serious!」

230:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... in a situation where none of us knows what tomorrow holds, the celebration for the ace pilots will have to wait until next time.」

230:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That said, I have a dimensional merchant's grit! No matter the situation, the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ stays open for business!」

230:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then...! Here's to everyone's bright futures~! Let's give it our all again today... business, business!」

231:t_000:0.en:
$$マックス$$
「We drove back the first wave, but we've taken considerable damage ourselves...」

231:t_000:1.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Leaving our main force, starting with $$エメラルドフォース$$, behind to guard the fleet has backfired on us, I'm afraid.」

231:t_000:2.en:
$$マックス$$
「It's no use talking about results after the fact...! Here they come!」

231:t_001:0.en:
$$マックス$$
「$$サイデリアル$$...! Are they going to eliminate us for approaching the center of the galaxy!」

231:t_001:1.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「The difference in strength between us and them is overwhelming, I'm afraid...」

231:t_002:0.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「What shall we do, Captain? They are not the sort to accept a surrender.」

231:t_002:1.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「And yet, in this situation, they won't even give us the chance to withdraw.」

231:t_002:2.en:
$$マックス$$
「It isn't over yet...! They're here!」

231:t_003:3.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Captain $$マックス$$! We'll take it from here! $$バトル７$$, fall back for now!」

231:t_003:4.en:
$$マックス$$
「My apologies...! We'll gladly take you up on that!」

231:t_003:5.en:
$$マックス$$
「$$バトル７$$, fall back! All units, follow!」

231:t_004:0.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Captain $$マックス$$, I'm glad you're safe.」

231:t_004:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I expected it, but that's a huge number of enemies...!」

231:t_004:2.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$, how is it?」

231:t_004:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「One battalion of the $$サイデリアル$$ Galactic Center Area Army confirmed.」

231:t_004:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「So even that force is only a small part of what they have.」

231:t_004:5.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Are they after $$ネオ・ラクス$$... or us...」

231:t_005:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Even facing such a huge force, he's no different than usual...」

231:t_005:2.en:
$$カイエン$$
「What is going on inside that guy's head!?」

231:t_005:3.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「It's completely beyond my understanding...」

231:t_005:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「Come on, $$マリーダ$$. $$バサラ$$'s songs always give me energy.」
